name: Auth
title: Templates/Platform/Auth
summary: The signed-out screens of a platform app, frame included: a full-height page with the signed-out `GlobalHeader` (the product mark and a Documentation button) over a centred column that holds one `Card` and the prompt and terms under it. It serves /login, /signup and /signup/verify. The Google and GitHub buttons lead the card, over an “or” `Separator`. Each field is a required `Label` over `Input` or a `Field` with `PasswordInput` and `PasswordRequirements`; a `HelperText` appears only after the primary action, saying whether the field is empty or malformed. The rest is `Button`, `IconButton` in a `Tooltip`, a `Tag` and a `Alert`. Errors follow one rule: auth never toasts. Each error story is one endpoint response, and every outcome lands in the same small `Alert` at the top of the card, above the fields. What changes is the severity and what it carries: nothing after a 401, because the fields under it are the recovery; Retry when nobody can fix it (503, 500, timeout); the Sign in and reset-your-password links when the address is already registered (409). Built from `PageHeader`, `GlobalHeader`, `Tag`, `Card`, `Alert`, `Label`, `Input`, `Field`, `PasswordInput`, `PasswordRequirements`, `HelperText` and `Button`.

variants.name: SignUp
variants.summary: The sign-up screen: create an account with a work email, Google or GitHub.

variants.name: SessionExpired
variants.summary: The /login screen after a session expires: it opens on the password step for the same email, with an info Alert that clears on the next action.

variants.name: CheckInbox
variants.summary: The /signup/verify screen: where the verification link went, the resend prompt, and a secondary Return to sign in action.

variants.name: IncorrectCredentials
variants.summary: 401 on Sign in: a danger message above both fields with no action, and the password cleared.

variants.name: ServiceUnavailable
variants.summary: 503 on Sign in: a warning message that keeps the credentials and carries Retry, the only move left.

variants.name: ServerError
variants.summary: 500 on the POST: tied to no field, so where the console would toast, the card keeps a danger message with Retry.

variants.name: Timeout
variants.summary: No response: the same message as the 500 but warning, because the request may still have gone through, with Retry.

variants.name: EmailAlreadyRegistered
variants.summary: 409 on Sign up: a danger message carrying the two ways out as links, Sign in or reset your password, with the address left in the field.

variants.name: MfaSetup
variants.summary: Turn on multi-factor authentication: steps, the QR code with a copyable setup key, and a 6-digit OtpInput that verifies on complete; wrong code on the field, no answer as a warning with Retry.

variants.name: MfaCode
variants.summary: The sign-in MFA challenge: an autofocused 6-digit OtpInput that submits when full, a recovery-code mode (8 characters, grouped), and Sign in with another account.
